home.chip: Online championship · CarX Drift Racing Online 2
home.lead: Qualifying, Top 32 tandem battles and season standings — all in one place, live.

qual.title: Qualifying
qual.text: Three runs: a warm-up and two scored attempts. Three judges score angle, style and line — up to 100 points.

bracket.title: Top 32 bracket
bracket.text: The best qualifiers make the bracket. The higher qualifier leads the pair.

final.title: Battles to the final
final.text: Two runs with swapped roles, judges' votes, up to two OMTs. The winner takes 250 season points.

me.numberKeep: This number stays yours. You can change it until you sign up for a round this season.

me.numberTaken: Someone just took this number — pick another one
me.numberLocked: You have signed up for a round this season, so your number is locked until the season ends. Only an admin can change it.
me.numberUntilSignup: Your number stays with you between seasons. You can change it until you sign up for a round this season — after that it is locked for the season and only an admin can change it.
me.liveryHint: A screenshot of your car — it becomes your profile cover. PNG, JPG or WebP, the site compresses it for you.
me.guest: Sign in with Steam to pick a race number, upload your livery and register for rounds.
